runtime/api-quickstart.js.title: Runtime API Quickstart
runtime/api-quickstart.js.description: A compact introduction to common OpenDesk Runtime globals and execution context.
runtime/api-quickstart.js.expected: The script prints its quickstart values and exits successfully.

runtime/console.js.title: Console Output
runtime/console.js.description: Print log, info, warning, error, object, group, and timing output without changing the desktop.
runtime/console.js.expected: Representative console output is printed and the execution exits successfully.

runtime/global-this.js.title: Global Runtime Object
runtime/global-this.js.description: Inspect globalThis and temporarily attach values and functions within the current execution.
runtime/global-this.js.expected: Temporary global values are created, read, and removed inside the execution.

runtime/promise.js.title: Promises
runtime/promise.js.description: Use await, Promise.all, rejection handling, and Promise.race in OpenDesk JavaScript.
runtime/promise.js.expected: Promise results and the race winner are printed.

runtime/sleep.js.title: Sleep
runtime/sleep.js.description: Pause an execution with sleep() and sleepSeconds().
runtime/sleep.js.expected: The example resumes after bounded waits and completes.

runtime/timer.js.title: Timers
runtime/timer.js.description: Use setTimeout, setInterval, clearTimeout, and clearInterval.
runtime/timer.js.expected: Scheduled callbacks run and the canceled timeout does not run.

runtime/environment.js.title: Environment
runtime/environment.js.description: Read selected execution environment information without dumping the complete process environment.
runtime/environment.js.expected: Selected environment values and execution context are printed.

runtime/path.js.title: Paths and Script Context
runtime/path.js.description: Inspect path helpers together with Execution.scriptPath and Execution.scriptDir.
runtime/path.js.expected: Normalized repository and script-context paths are printed.

runtime/file.js.title: File Operations
runtime/file.js.description: Create, read, copy, move, and validate files inside the example artifact area.
runtime/file.js.expected: The example validates its isolated file operations and exits successfully.

runtime/file-json.js.title: JSON Files
runtime/file-json.js.description: Read and write JSON through the OpenDesk File API using execution-owned async operations.
runtime/file-json.js.expected: JSON data is written, read back, and printed from the execution artifact area.

runtime/command.js.title: Command
runtime/command.js.description: Run the platform's fixed echo command through Command.run() and validate the bounded result.
runtime/command.js.expected: A fixed echo child process succeeds and its bounded output is validated.

runtime/page-wait.js.title: Page Wait
runtime/page-wait.js.description: Use fixed waits, condition polling, AbortSignal cancellation, and waitForAll without desktop input.
runtime/page-wait.js.expected: Bounded wait examples complete and cancellation is reported.

runtime/app-storage.js.title: App Storage
runtime/app-storage.js.description: Store text and JSON strings in persistent application storage using execution-scoped example keys.
prerequisites: Writes persistent AppStorage values using a key prefixed with the current Execution.id.
runtime/app-storage.js.expected: Text and JSON values round-trip successfully.

runtime/system-info.js.title: System Information
runtime/system-info.js.description: Inspect local system, process, network, user, and hardware information.
prerequisites: Review output before sharing logs; it can include host- or user-identifying information.
runtime/system-info.js.expected: Detailed local system information is printed.

runtime/system-session-state.js.title: System Session State
runtime/system-session-state.js.description: Read session capability metadata and the current session state when supported.
runtime/system-session-state.js.expected: Capabilities and supported session state are printed.

desktop/display-modes.js.title: Display Modes
desktop/display-modes.js.description: Read display capability metadata, current display modes, and available mode counts.

desktop/window-inspect.js.title: Window Inspect
desktop/window-inspect.js.description: Inspect desktop windows without changing their state.
prerequisites: Window titles or application identity may be sensitive when sharing logs.

desktop/keyboard.js.title: Keyboard Input
desktop/keyboard.js.description: Send bounded keyboard input to an explicitly configured target window.
prerequisites: Requires the explicit input opt-in and exact target identity documented in examples/desktop/README.md.
desktop/keyboard.js.expected: The configured disposable target receives the bounded input.

desktop/window-controls.js.title: Window Controls
desktop/window-controls.js.description: Move and restore an explicitly configured disposable target window.
prerequisites: Requires explicit window-change opt-in and exact target identity.
desktop/window-controls.js.expected: The target bounds are changed, verified, and restored.

desktop/ui-relative-target.js.title: UI Relative Text Target
desktop/ui-relative-target.js.description: Resolve one text target relative to another text inside the active disposable window and click it once.
prerequisites: Requires a disposable window containing the documented two-row text fixture and performs one real click.
desktop/ui-relative-target.js.expected: The Edit text to the right of the reviewed anchor row is clicked once.

desktop/mouse.js.title: Mouse Input
desktop/mouse.js.description: Demonstrate pointer position, fixed-coordinate click, move, wheel, and right-click APIs.
prerequisites: Performs real desktop input at fixed coordinates; review the script and use a disposable desktop state.
desktop/mouse.js.expected: Pointer actions are sent to the reviewed coordinates.

desktop/page-click.js.title: Page Click and Screenshot
desktop/page-click.js.description: Demonstrate fixed-coordinate page.mouse clicks followed by screenshot capture.
prerequisites: Performs real desktop clicks at fixed coordinates and captures visible pixels.
desktop/page-click.js.expected: Reviewed pointer actions run and screenshots are written under .runtime/examples/desktop/page-click/.

desktop/screen-info.js.title: Screen Information
desktop/screen-info.js.description: Read screen size and pixel samples, then capture a full-screen image preview.
prerequisites: Captures visible desktop pixels; close sensitive content before running.
desktop/screen-info.js.expected: Screen geometry, sampled pixels, and a bounded screenshot preview are printed.

desktop/screenshot.js.title: Screenshot
desktop/screenshot.js.description: Capture full and clipped screenshots and write artifacts under .runtime/examples/desktop/screenshot/.
prerequisites: Captures visible desktop pixels; close sensitive content before running.
desktop/screenshot.js.expected: Screenshot artifacts are written locally and bounded previews are printed.

desktop/screenshot-bytes.js.title: Screenshot Bytes
desktop/screenshot-bytes.js.description: Capture the active window as bytes and persist a PNG under .runtime/examples/desktop/screenshot-bytes/.
prerequisites: Captures the active window; close sensitive content before running.
desktop/screenshot-bytes.js.expected: Byte length, PNG signature bytes, and output path are printed.

desktop/screen-record-region.js.title: Record Screen Region
desktop/screen-record-region.js.description: Select a desktop region and record a short local movie artifact.
prerequisites: Requires screen-recording permission and captures visible pixels from the selected region.
desktop/screen-record-region.js.expected: A finalized recording is written under .runtime/examples/desktop/screen-record-region/.

vision/image-color-basic.js.title: Image Color Basics
vision/image-color-basic.js.description: Compare colors and inspect pixels from a captured screenshot without sending desktop input.
prerequisites: Captures visible desktop pixels; close sensitive content before running.
vision/image-color-basic.js.expected: Color similarity, image size, a sampled pixel, and a bounded color match are printed.

vision/bytes-roundtrip.js.title: Vision Bytes Roundtrip
vision/bytes-roundtrip.js.description: Capture active-window bytes, persist them, and send the same bytes to OCR.
prerequisites: Requires the configured Paddle OCR provider and captures active-window pixels.
vision/bytes-roundtrip.js.expected: The PNG artifact and OCR metadata are printed.

vision/ocr.js.title: OCR and Text Target
vision/ocr.js.description: Run OCR, resolve visible text through UI.findText(), and click the matched target.
prerequisites: Requires Paddle OCR configuration and performs a real click on the resolved text target.
vision/ocr.js.expected: OCR metadata and the resolved text target are printed; if found, the target is clicked.

audio/play.js.title: Play Sounds
audio/play.js.description: Play built-in and repository audio through the legacy synchronous Sound methods.
prerequisites: Uses the audio output device and plays several audible sounds.

audio/playback-control.js.title: Playback Control
audio/playback-control.js.description: Start looping audio, pause, resume, stop, and wait for terminal playback state.
prerequisites: Uses the audio output device.
audio/playback-control.js.expected: Playback reaches stopped state and no active playback remains.

dialog/async-await.js.title: Dialog with async/await
dialog/async-await.js.description: Use native alert, confirm, and prompt dialogs with async/await.
prerequisites: Run with Custom UI enabled; requires a supported native UI host.
dialog/async-await.js.expected: The user completes or cancels the native dialog flow.

dialog/promise-chain.js.title: Dialog with Promise Chain
dialog/promise-chain.js.description: Run the same native Dialog flow with Promise chaining instead of async/await.
prerequisites: Run with Custom UI enabled; requires a supported native UI host.
dialog/promise-chain.js.expected: The user completes or cancels the native dialog flow.

custom-ui/panel.js.title: Custom UI Panel
custom-ui/panel.js.description: Create a structured ui.createWindow() panel with HTML/CSS and Runtime-owned event handlers.
prerequisites: Run with Custom UI enabled; ui.createWindow() requires the supported UI host/WebView capability.
custom-ui/panel.js.expected: A native-hosted Custom UI panel opens and remains interactive until closed.

custom-ui/form.js.title: Custom UI Form
custom-ui/form.js.description: Create a form-style Custom UI surface and handle its controls from JavaScript.
prerequisites: Run with Custom UI enabled.
custom-ui/form.js.expected: The form opens and JavaScript receives control events.

custom-ui/five-button-toolbar.js.title: Five Button Toolbar
custom-ui/five-button-toolbar.js.description: Build a compact native FloatingWindow toolbar with five direct button actions.
prerequisites: Run with Custom UI enabled.
custom-ui/five-button-toolbar.js.expected: A five-button native toolbar opens and reports user actions.

custom-ui/floating-toolbar-primitives.js.title: Floating Toolbar Primitives
custom-ui/floating-toolbar-primitives.js.description: Demonstrate native toolbar Button, Separator, Spacer, WindowState, move, and close lifecycle behavior.
prerequisites: Run with Custom UI enabled.
custom-ui/floating-toolbar-primitives.js.expected: The native toolbar opens and logs its lifecycle and interaction state.

notifications/send.js.title: Send Notification
notifications/send.js.description: Send short OpenDesk notifications through the Runtime notification API.
prerequisites: Shows real system notifications and may play notification sound.
notifications/send.js.expected: The system displays the example notifications.

notifications/lifecycle.js.title: Notification Lifecycle
notifications/lifecycle.js.description: Wait for an own-app notification, inspect delivery metadata, and dismiss it.
prerequisites: Shows and dismisses a real system notification.
notifications/lifecycle.js.expected: Delivery metadata is observed and the notification is dismissed.

events/global-shortcut-permission-setup..title: Global Shortcut Permission Setup
events/global-shortcut-permission-setup..description: Preflight macOS global-shortcut permissions and open only the missing System Settings privacy pages.
prerequisites: May open macOS System Settings to the missing Accessibility or Input Monitoring permission.
events/global-shortcut-permission-setup..expected: The required global-shortcut permissions are reported as ready or the missing settings page is opened.

events/global-shortcut.js.title: Global Shortcut
events/global-shortcut.js.description: Register a global keyboard shortcut owned by the current execution and handle it with a JavaScript callback.
prerequisites: Registers CommandOrControl+Shift+q globally; on macOS configure permissions first; triggering it writes fixed example text to the clipboard.
events/global-shortcut.js.expected: The shortcut stays registered for this execution and the callback runs when the user presses it.

app/running-apps.js.title: Running Applications Overview
app/running-apps.js.description: Read the window list and summarize several common desktop applications without changing them.
prerequisites: Window titles can contain user information; review output before sharing logs.
app/running-apps.js.expected: Matching application windows and their dimensions are printed.

app/wechat-window-inspect.js.title: WeChat Window Inspect
app/wechat-window-inspect.js.description: Find WeChat windows without changing application state.
prerequisites: Window titles can contain user information; review output before sharing logs.
app/wechat-window-inspect.js.expected: Detected WeChat windows and their dimensions are printed.

app/open-calculator-by-name.js.title: Open Calculator by Name
app/open-calculator-by-name.js.description: Launch or activate macOS Calculator by its native application name and print the observed identity.
prerequisites: Launches or activates the real Calculator application.
app/open-calculator-by-name.js.expected: Calculator becomes available and its native identity is printed.

app/lifecycle-calculator.js.title: Calculator App Lifecycle
app/lifecycle-calculator.js.description: Launch, restart, terminate and verify macOS Calculator when no operator instance is already running.
prerequisites: Calculator must not already be running; the example launches, restarts and terminates the real application.
app/lifecycle-calculator.js.expected: Lifecycle evidence is written under .runtime/examples/app/lifecycle-calculator/ and Calculator is not left running by the example.
